one_liner_zh: 通用对话助手，覆盖写作、编程与日常问答。
one_liner_en: General-purpose chat assistant for writing, coding and Q&A.
use_when_zh: 需要快速草稿、头脑风暴或多模态问答时。
use_when_en: You need fast drafts, brainstorming or multimodal Q&A.
avoid_when_zh: 需要严格可追溯引用来源或企业强合规审计时。
avoid_when_en: You need strict citation trails or heavy enterprise compliance.

one_liner_zh: 长上下文写作与编程助手，擅长细致分析。
one_liner_en: Long-context writing and coding assistant strong at careful analysis.
use_when_zh: 处理长文档、复杂代码库或需要谨慎推理时。
use_when_en: Working with long docs, complex codebases or careful reasoning.
avoid_when_zh: 只要极短延迟的闲聊或实时联网检索时（用专用搜索工具更好）。
avoid_when_en: You only need ultra-low-latency chat or live web search.

one_liner_zh: 谷歌生态内的多模态助手，擅长检索与文档协作。
one_liner_en: Google's multimodal assistant strong at search and Docs workflows.
use_when_zh: 已在用 Google Workspace，需要联网与多模态时。
use_when_en: You already use Google Workspace and need web + multimodal.
avoid_when_zh: 希望完全脱离谷歌账号与数据生态时。
avoid_when_en: You want to stay fully outside Google's account ecosystem.

one_liner_zh: 面向营销团队的品牌文案与内容流水线。
one_liner_en: Brand copy and content pipelines for marketing teams.
use_when_zh: 需要品牌语气一致、多渠道营销内容批量产出时。
use_when_en: You need on-brand multi-channel marketing content at scale.
avoid_when_zh: 个人临时写一两篇博客——通用聊天模型更便宜。
avoid_when_en: One-off personal blog posts — a general chat model is cheaper.

one_liner_zh: 销售与 GTM 团队的文案与工作流自动化。
one_liner_en: Copy and workflow automation for sales and GTM teams.
use_when_zh: 要批量产出销售邮件、落地页与社媒文案时。
use_when_en: Batching sales emails, landing pages and social copy.
avoid_when_zh: 需要深度技术长文或学术写作时。
avoid_when_en: You need deep technical long-form or academic writing.

one_liner_zh: 高质量艺术风格图像生成，社区氛围强。
one_liner_en: High-quality artistic image generation with a strong community.
use_when_zh: 要概念艺术、海报或有风格感的视觉时。
use_when_en: You want concept art, posters or stylized visuals.
avoid_when_zh: 需要精确文字渲染或可商用素材的严格版权证明时。
avoid_when_en: You need exact text-in-image or strict commercial rights proof.

one_liner_zh: AI 视频生成与剪辑套件，适合短片与特效。
one_liner_en: AI video generation and editing suite for shorts and effects.
use_when_zh: 要从文本/图片生成短视频或做创意特效时。
use_when_en: Generating short clips from text/image or creative VFX.
avoid_when_zh: 只要简单字幕剪辑——剪映/CapCut 更轻。
avoid_when_en: Simple caption edits — CapCut is lighter.

one_liner_zh: 国产高质量文生视频与图生视频工具。
one_liner_en: Strong text-to-video and image-to-video from China.
use_when_zh: 需要较长镜头、运动流畅的 AI 视频时。
use_when_en: You want longer shots with smooth motion in AI video.
avoid_when_zh: 团队必须全英文工作流且要欧美合规托管时。
avoid_when_en: Your team needs fully English workflows and EU/US hosting.

one_liner_zh: 电影级运镜与角色一致的 AI 视频创作平台。
one_liner_en: Cinematic camera moves and character-consistent AI video.
use_when_zh: 要可控运镜、角色一致性强的短片时。
use_when_en: You need controllable camera and consistent characters.
avoid_when_zh: 只要静态插画——用图像模型更划算。
avoid_when_en: Static illustrations only — image models are cheaper.

one_liner_zh: 云端 ComfyUI / 工作流平台，免装本地环境。
one_liner_en: Cloud ComfyUI / workflow platform without local setup.
use_when_zh: 想跑复杂图像工作流但不想维护本地 GPU 时。
use_when_en: You want complex image workflows without local GPUs.
avoid_when_zh: 数据绝不能出本机、或工作流极简单时。
avoid_when_en: Data must stay on-device, or your workflow is trivial.

one_liner_zh: AI 原生代码编辑器，适合日常开发与重构。
one_liner_en: AI-native code editor for day-to-day coding and refactors.
use_when_zh: 在真实代码库里写功能、修 bug、做 code review 时。
use_when_en: Building features, fixing bugs and reviewing in real repos.
avoid_when_zh: 完全不会编程、只想一句话出完整产品时（可先试 vibe 平台）。
avoid_when_en: Non-coders who only want one-shot apps — try vibe platforms first.

one_liner_zh: 嵌入 IDE 的补全与聊天助手，GitHub 深度集成。
one_liner_en: IDE completion and chat deeply integrated with GitHub.
use_when_zh: 已在用 VS Code / JetBrains 且仓库在 GitHub 时。
use_when_en: You use VS Code / JetBrains and repos live on GitHub.
avoid_when_zh: 需要完全离线或非 GitHub 托管的强隔离环境时。
avoid_when_en: Fully offline or non-GitHub strongly isolated environments.

one_liner_zh: 用自然语言生成 React / Tailwind UI 组件。
one_liner_en: Generate React / Tailwind UI components from natural language.
use_when_zh: 快速出前端界面原型并导出到 Next.js 时。
use_when_en: Prototyping UI fast and exporting into Next.js.
avoid_when_zh: 要做后端逻辑或非 Web UI 时。
avoid_when_en: Backend logic or non-web UI work.

one_liner_zh: 浏览器里 vibe coding：一句话搭全栈小应用。
one_liner_en: In-browser vibe coding: full-stack apps from a prompt.
use_when_zh: 想快速验证想法、不配本地环境时。
use_when_en: Validating ideas fast without local setup.
avoid_when_zh: 大型遗留系统或严格企业安全要求时。
avoid_when_en: Large legacy systems or strict enterprise security needs.

one_liner_zh: 云端 IDE 里的 Agent，能建应用并部署。
one_liner_en: Cloud IDE agent that builds and deploys apps.
use_when_zh: 希望从提示到部署一条龙在浏览器完成时。
use_when_en: You want prompt-to-deploy entirely in the browser.
avoid_when_zh: 需要私有 VPC / 自有基础设施深度集成时。
avoid_when_en: Deep private VPC / own-infra integration is required.

one_liner_zh: Cascade Agent 驱动的 AI IDE，强调多文件协作。
one_liner_en: Cascade-agent AI IDE focused on multi-file collaboration.
use_when_zh: 需要跨多文件的 Agent 式改码体验时。
use_when_en: You want agentic edits across many files.
avoid_when_zh: 团队已深度绑定其他 IDE 生态且切换成本高时。
avoid_when_en: Team is locked into another IDE with high switching cost.

one_liner_zh: 构建 LLM 应用与有状态 Agent 工作流的框架。
one_liner_en: Framework for LLM apps and stateful agent workflows.
use_when_zh: 要自建可编排的 Agent / RAG 流水线时。
use_when_en: Building your own orchestrated agent / RAG pipelines.
avoid_when_zh: 只要开箱即用聊天机器人、不想写代码时。
avoid_when_en: You only want a no-code chatbot.

one_liner_zh: 多角色 Agent 协作框架，适合角色分工任务。
one_liner_en: Multi-agent crew framework for role-based tasks.
use_when_zh: 要把调研、写作、审查拆成多个 Agent 角色时。
use_when_en: Splitting research, writing and review across agent roles.
avoid_when_zh: 单步问答或简单 RAG 就够用时。
avoid_when_en: Single-step Q&A or simple RAG is enough.

one_liner_zh: 开源 LLM 应用开发平台，可视化编排工作流。
one_liner_en: Open-source LLM app platform with visual workflow builders.
use_when_zh: 要快速搭 RAG / Agent 应用并可自托管时。
use_when_en: Spinning up RAG / agent apps with optional self-hosting.
avoid_when_zh: 只要消费级聊天、无部署需求时。
avoid_when_en: Consumer chat only with no deployment needs.

one_liner_zh: 带引用来源的 AI 搜索引擎，适合快速调研。
one_liner_en: AI search with citations — great for quick research.
use_when_zh: 需要可点击来源的答案与市场/技术速查时。
use_when_en: You need clickable sources for market or tech lookups.
avoid_when_zh: 超长私有文档库深度分析（用专用 RAG 更好）。
avoid_when_en: Deep analysis of huge private corpora — use dedicated RAG.

one_liner_zh: 基于科学论文的 AI 检索，强调证据摘要。
one_liner_en: AI search over scientific papers with evidence summaries.
use_when_zh: 做学术/医学/科研相关问题核验时。
use_when_en: Validating academic, medical or scientific questions.
avoid_when_zh: 查最新产品发布或非学术新闻时。
avoid_when_en: Tracking product launches or non-academic news.

one_liner_zh: 面向开发者的神经搜索 API，适合 Agent 取数。
one_liner_en: Neural search API for developers — great for agent retrieval.
use_when_zh: 给 Agent / RAG 接高质量网页检索 API 时。
use_when_en: Wiring high-quality web retrieval into agents / RAG.
avoid_when_zh: 终端用户只要一个搜索框聊天界面时。
avoid_when_en: End users who only want a chat search box.

one_liner_zh: 嵌在 Notion 工作区里的写作与知识库助手。
one_liner_en: Writing and wiki assistant embedded in Notion workspaces.
use_when_zh: 团队知识已在 Notion，需要总结与起草时。
use_when_en: Team knowledge already lives in Notion for summarize/draft.
avoid_when_zh: 主要工作流在 Google Docs / Confluence 时。
avoid_when_en: Your primary docs live in Google Docs / Confluence.

one_liner_zh: 一句话生成可编辑演示文稿与文档。
one_liner_en: Generate editable decks and docs from a prompt.
use_when_zh: 要快速出一轮汇报 PPT / 提案初稿时。
use_when_en: You need a first-pass presentation or proposal fast.
avoid_when_zh: 企业模板与品牌规范极严、必须用官方母版时。
avoid_when_en: Strict corporate masters that must use official templates.

one_liner_zh: 会议录音转写、摘要与待办自动提取。
one_liner_en: Meeting transcription, summaries and action-item extraction.
use_when_zh: 线上会议多、需要自动纪要同步 CRM 时。
use_when_en: Many online meetings and auto notes into CRM.
avoid_when_zh: 会议涉及高度机密且不能第三方录音时。
avoid_when_en: Highly confidential meetings that cannot be third-party recorded.

one_liner_zh: 实时会议笔记与协作转写工具。
one_liner_en: Live meeting notes and collaborative transcription.
use_when_zh: 需要实时字幕与会后可搜索笔记时。
use_when_en: You want live captions and searchable post-meeting notes.
avoid_when_zh: 主要语言非英语且准确率要求极高时需先试用。
avoid_when_en: Non-English primary language with strict accuracy — trial first.

one_liner_zh: 模型、数据集与 Space 的开源 AI 枢纽。
one_liner_en: Open hub for models, datasets and Spaces.
use_when_zh: 找开源模型、试用 Space 或发模型卡片时。
use_when_en: Finding open models, trying Spaces or publishing model cards.
avoid_when_zh: 只要闭源 SaaS 聊天、无技术背景时。
avoid_when_en: Closed SaaS chat only with no technical background.

one_liner_zh: xAI 助手，实时结合 X 上的信息与工具调用。
one_liner_en: xAI assistant with real-time X context and tool use.
use_when_zh: 要结合热点与实时社交信息做调研/创作时。
use_when_en: Research or creation that benefits from live social context.
avoid_when_zh: 完全不使用 X、且需要其他生态深度集成时。
avoid_when_en: You never use X and need other ecosystem-deep integrations.

one_liner_zh: 开源的人机审批层，让 AI Agent 在关键步骤前征求人类确认。
one_liner_en: Open-source human-approval layer so AI agents pause for people on critical steps.
use_when_zh: 部署会改数据、发消息或花钱的 Agent，需要人工闸门时。
use_when_en: Agents that change data, send messages, or spend money need a human gate.
avoid_when_zh: 纯只读问答、或不想引入额外审批流程时。
avoid_when_en: Read-only Q&A, or you don’t want an approval workflow.

one_liner_zh: 面向合同审阅与合规的法律向 AI 模型（Z.ai）。
one_liner_en: Legal-focused AI model from Z.ai for contract review and compliance.
use_when_zh: 需要快速过合同条款、合规要点草稿时（仍需律师复核）。
use_when_en: Drafting contract/compliance reviews — always have a lawyer verify.
avoid_when_zh: 把输出当最终法律意见，或处理高度机密未脱敏材料时。
avoid_when_en: Treating output as final legal advice, or feeding unsanitized secrets.

one_liner_zh: 私密语音备忘录，可选用你指定的 AI 来整理。
one_liner_en: Private voice memos with the AI provider you choose.
use_when_zh: 想用语音记灵感/待办，又在意隐私与模型选择时。
use_when_en: Voice capture for ideas/todos when privacy and model choice matter.
avoid_when_zh: 只要简单系统自带录音、无需 AI 整理时。
avoid_when_en: Plain phone voice memos with no AI cleanup needed.

one_liner_zh: 面向运行时的 AI 后端 QA 工程师，帮你抓接口与服务问题。
one_liner_en: AI runtime backend QA engineer for catching API and service issues.
use_when_zh: 后端服务多、希望 AI 辅助做运行时质量检查时。
use_when_en: Many backend services and you want AI-assisted runtime QA.
avoid_when_zh: 纯前端静态站、或已有完善传统测试体系且无需 AI 时。
avoid_when_en: Static frontends only, or classic tests already cover you fully.

one_liner_zh: 通过 MCP 让 ChatGPT / Claude 直接处理客服工单。
one_liner_en: Let ChatGPT & Claude handle support tickets via MCP.
use_when_zh: 客服工单量大，想把常用回复与查询接到大模型时。
use_when_en: High ticket volume and you want LLMs wired into support workflows.
avoid_when_zh: 工单含强监管/不可外泄客户数据且未做好脱敏时。
avoid_when_en: Regulated or sensitive customer data without redaction controls.

one_liner_zh: 在云端运行机器人相关 AI 模型的平台。
one_liner_en: Run strong robot AI models in the cloud.
use_when_zh: 做机器人/仿真相关原型，需要云端模型推理时。
use_when_en: Robotics or sim prototypes that need cloud model inference.
avoid_when_zh: 与机器人无关的普通办公/写作任务。
avoid_when_en: Everyday writing or office work unrelated to robotics.

one_liner_zh: Google 开源的向量嵌入模型，适合检索与 RAG。
one_liner_en: Google’s open embedding model for retrieval and RAG.
use_when_zh: 自建搜索/RAG，需要可靠的文本向量时。
use_when_en: Building search/RAG and need solid text embeddings.
avoid_when_zh: 只要现成 SaaS 搜索、不想自己部署模型时。
avoid_when_en: You only want turnkey SaaS search with no model hosting.

one_liner_zh: 通义千问图像生成模型（Turbo），开源可自托管。
one_liner_en: Qwen text-to-image model (Turbo) — open and self-hostable.
use_when_zh: 要开源文生图、可本地或私有化部署时。
use_when_en: You want open text-to-image with local/private deploy options.
avoid_when_zh: 只要最省事的网页点选出图（用 Midjourney 等更轻）。
avoid_when_en: You only want the easiest web UI — Midjourney-class apps are lighter.

one_liner_zh: 开源多模态模型，擅长看图问答与图文理解。
one_liner_en: Open multimodal model for image Q&A and vision-language tasks.
use_when_zh: 需要私有化/开源的看图理解与图文对话时。
use_when_en: Private/open vision-language chat and image understanding.
avoid_when_zh: 只要手机 App 里随手问一张图（用消费级助手即可）。
avoid_when_en: Casual one-off photo questions in a consumer chat app.

one_liner_zh: 热门 HF Space：用对话快速生成网站页面。
one_liner_en: Popular HF Space for building site pages from chat prompts.
use_when_zh: 想快速出落地页/小站原型、先看效果时。
use_when_en: Spinning up landing-page or small-site prototypes fast.
avoid_when_zh: 企业级大站、复杂权限与后端一体交付时。
avoid_when_en: Large enterprise sites with complex auth and backends.
